verdict.rationale: The dots docs mention using your dot in a desktop app, where you can open its profile and inspect Activity (dots-docs-13). Connecting your computer gives the dot access to local files, code, and apps (dots-docs-10), which comes close to local access but is not the same as seeing what is on your screen. Missing for 10: documented OS-level/global keyboard shortcuts, evidence that the dot can see or capture the user's screen, a desktop app documented in depth beyond a single mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
